title: Number of Comments per Post
sourceNote: AI-authored requirements draft local-reference/leetcode/manual/1241.txt; no recovered raw statement exists in the archive (index status missing-statement).
summary: Submissions holds posts (parent_id NULL) and comments (parent_id references a post). For every distinct post return post_id and the number of distinct comment IDs that reference it. Zero-comment posts are included.
inputFormat: Submissions(sub_id, parent_id); rows may be duplicated.
tieRules: Sorted by post_id ascending. Duplicate post and comment rows count once each.
edgeRules: A post with no comments returns 0.
